name: model_turbulence_with_pink_noise
mechanism: Replaces white noise with pink noise (1/f power spectrum) to more accurately model the natural energy roll-off of fluid turbulence and physiological background noise.

name: physiological_systole_duration_scaling
mechanism: Scales the systole duration proportionally to the square root of the RR interval to approximate physiological QT interval scaling.

name: pink_noise_valve_snap
mechanism: Replaces white noise with pink noise and lowers the upper cutoff frequency for valve closure snaps to prevent unrealistic high-frequency artifacts.

name: increase_heart_rate_range
mechanism: Increases the simulated heart rate range to better reflect pediatric populations and increase the temporal density of cardiac cycles.
